description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to parsing, comparing, and handling release versions and npm publish plans. It includes regex patterns for version string matching, functions for parsing version strings into structured data, comparison logic for version ordering, and methods for determining npm publish configurations and authentication handling.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object, handling stable, beta, and correction versions.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two release version strings, returning their ordering as a number, accounting for date, channel, and version number.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the npm publish plan (channel and tags) based on the version string and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Resolves the authentication method for npm dist tag mirroring based on provided tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Decides whether npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and authentication presence.
